sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Remove the first two top-level sh:or alternative groups and encode the independent implications. The forefoot requirement applies only to IA Super; IA and the lower ice classes must not be forced to have openWaterServiceSpeed below 18, and the advisory lower-speed model-test sentence must not become mandatory. The upper-bow requirement applies only to IA Super or IA when openWaterServiceSpeed is at least 18; lower-speed IA/IA Super cases need no strengthening-status evidence.
